rows.description: Full-color flat FDM printing with calibrated filament layer mixing. Reproduce image colors and tonal detail, fine-tune local recipes, and export slicer-ready 3MF files.
The official Open-Asset-Importer-Library Repository. Loads 40+ 3D-file-formats into one unified and clean data structure.

3D & AR SDK for Android (Jetpack Compose + Filament), Apple (SwiftUI + RealityKit), Web, Flutter and React Native. Opens glTF/GLB, 3MF, STL, OBJ and PLY on Android and USDZ on Apple, at real size in AR. Assistant-ready: in-repo MCP server, AGENTS.md and llms.txt — no assistant-specific setup.

JSCAD is an open source set of modular, browser and command line tools for creating parametric 2D and 3D designs with JavaScript code. It provides a quick, precise and reproducible method for generating 3D models, and is especially useful for creating ready-to-print 3D designs.
